_doc: Stream B. Which world zones each of stream E's province sheets uses (data/provinces/<id>.json `zones.<id>.grid`). block = the world zone (zx, zy) of E's grid [0,0]; map = E zone id -> world zone id. tools/bake-zone.mjs reads it for per-zone sites (an event arena per zone; the world boss arena in the sheet's worldBossZone). Re-run E's tools/assign-vignettes.mjs + place-vignettes.mjs after any change here. Optional per province: continent (tools/lib/world-core.mjs CONTINENTS id), culture (the proctown culture its settlements are planned in, overriding the World Forge race), worldBoss {zone, id} (asked for before the sheet exists). The first map entry is the province's landing (tools/lib/province-reach.mjs floods from it).
